programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Throughout the history of mankind - the business of curing, of understanding and treating disease, has taken a rather peculiar path. Some procedures have proven to be very efficient while other methods could only have made things worse for the patient. Up to the 16th Century "treating" someone could mean diminishing one of four bodily fluids, paving the way for bloodletting. As it turns out, modern science proves that bloodletting does help in rare cases. In fact, bloodsucking leeches are excellent helpers to cure wounds. We now know that one little creature is the cause for many diseases: bacteria. But until the mid-19th century, many felt that such tiny organisms such as germs could not possibly kill larger ones such as humans. After all, we can't even see them with the naked eye! How then, did we discover them? Thanks to one doctor who decided to take a good look …between his teeth. Since then, we have found a cure for most bacterial infections in the form of Antibiotics. This was accidently discovered by Alexander Fleming - whilst leaving the office for a holiday, he left a culture plate smeared with his personal nasal mucus on his lab bench only to find that mould surrounding this mucus actually inhibited its growth. In the new millennium, this discovery of such a "Superdrug" is threatened by the advent of the 'Superbug'. Have these cures led to bacteria becoming more tolerant and harder to kill? What else will the future bring? A cure against the flu?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Forests are crucial for our survival on Earth. They absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and supply all living forms with clean oxygen. "We are like a patient in a hospital bed that is turning down their oxygen tank and thinking they could live with a little bit less oxygen and meanwhile the CO2 is increasing in the room" says journalist Andrew Nikiforuk.

programme.title: Чародеи
programme.desc: Новогодняя сказка о том, что настоящая любовь может творить чудеса. В институте "НУИНУ" (Научный Универсальный Институт Необыкновенных Услуг) кипит бурная работа по изготовлению волшебной палочки. Презентация изобретения намечена на 31 декабря, в Новогодний вечер. Но тут в дело вступают противники директора института, преследующие свои цели… Режиссер - Константин Бромберг, в главных ролях - Александра Яковлева, Александр Абдулов, Екатерина Васильева, Валентин Гафт, Семен Фарада, Валерий Золотухин, Эммануил Виторган, Михаил Светин.

programme.title: Ёлки 3
programme.desc: Если ты сделал добро, тебе не обязательно ответят добром — это правда жизни. Ты помог кому-то, а тебе помог неизвестный… Случайно? Это бумеранг добра, который будет запущен героем нашей объединяющей истории, пройдет внутри других новелл, вызвав волну добрых поступков и серьезные изменения для всех героев, и вернется к тому, кто все начал, в тот момент, когда надеяться, кажется, будет уже не на что.

programme.title: Затерянный город Z
programme.desc: Биографический фильм, рассказывающий о жизни исследователя, топографа, путешественника и полковника британской империи Персвиваля Фоссетта. Делом всей жизни Фоссета стали поиски таинственного города Z"", затерянного в джунглях Южной Америки. За свою жизнь Фоссетт совершил несколько путешествий в сельву Амазонки. И в 1925 году, вместе со своим сыном он снова отправляется на поиски своей мечты. К сожалению, с тех пор о полковнике Фоссетте и его спутниках ничего не было слышно и что стало с экспедицией до сих пор неизвестно.

programme.title: Приключения Электроника
programme.desc: Советский ученый создает гениального робота. Это мальчик, который способен решать любые математические задачи, он пишет самые лучшие сочинения и отлично поет! А еще он — точная копия школьника Сережи Сыроежкина. Сообразительный мальчуган быстренько перекладывает все свои обязанности на электронного двойника. Тот делает за него домашние задания, ходит в школу и выполняет хозяйственные дела, которые Сыроежкину поручают родители…

programme.title: Завтрак у папы
programme.desc: У молодого, привлекательного и самовлюбленного Саши Титова в жизни, на первый взгляд, все сложилось как нельзя лучше: он успешный креативный директор рекламного агентства и полностью удовлетворен ни к чему не обязывающими отношениями с коллегой Оксаной Тарелкиной. Но однажды утром на пороге своего пентхауса Саша встречает милую десятилетнюю девчушку Алю, которая представляется его дочкой. Ворвавшись в жизнь Саши, смышленая и любознательная Аля серьезно намерена надолго в ней обосноваться. Но готов ли Саша принять все сюрпризы, приготовленные судьбой, и в корне изменить привычную холостяцкую жизнь?

2:22 по полудню. Безоблачное небо внезапно озаряет мощная световая вспышка. Приборы навигации выходят из строя. Два пассажирских самолета неизбежно должны столкнуться в воздухе. В последнее мгновение опытный авиадиспетчер Дилан успевает развести маршруты, но с этой минуты его жизнь не может быть прежней. В поисках страшной правды Дилан знакомится с таинственной девушкой по имени Сара, вместе с которой он открывает зловещую тайну пересечения судеб…

programme.title: Пара из будущего
programme.desc: Недалекое будущее, 2040 год. Евгений и Александра 20 лет в браке, их отношения похожи на высохший урюк. Развестись у них тоже не получается, поскольку в будущем расторжение брака - очень дорогая услуга. Но судьба дает им шанс: Евгений и Александра попадают в прошлое, в тот самый день 20 лет назад, когда влюбленный и юный Женя сделал предложение прелестной Саше. Теперь пара из будущего хочет разлучить самих себя в молодости, но это будет непросто. Молодые будут сражаться за свою любовь.

programme.title: На острие
programme.desc: Лучшая саблистка мира, Александра Покровская, знаменита, богата и счастлива. Чтобы войти в историю, ей остается сделать последний шаг - взять олимпийское золото. Но путь ей преграждает девятнадцатилетняя Кира Егорова, девушка из провинции, в одночасье покорившая Москву. Кира побеждает на всех соревнованиях и не сходит с обложек глянцевых журналов. Ее цель - занять место Покровской. Начинается отчаянная схватка не только на турнирах, но и в жизни. Обе одержимы, и, кажется, остановить их не может ничто. Весь мир, затаив дыхание, наблюдает за сверканием острых клинков. И все очевиднее: эта яростная борьба уже зашла слишком далеко...

programme.title: Небо. Самолёт. Девушка
programme.desc: Они увидели друг друга в кафе. Не встретиться они не могли, так как в этом кафе никого не было, кроме бармена. И затем в течение долгого времени они жили, не видя никого вокруг: любовь самодостаточна, она отвергает лишнее. Встречи на безлюдной станции метро \"Арбатская\". Он будет выкраивать время между командировками, она - между рейсами. Цветы и поцелуи на улице, под холодным дождем. Постель в его пустом светлом доме. Снова расставание. Но вскоре он поймет, что \"самая красивая девушка Москвы и Московской области\" - это его судьба...

programme.title: Как поднять миллион. Исповедь Z@drota
programme.desc: Леша и Алена вот-вот должны пожениться. И все бы ничего, если бы не знакомство Леши с известной журналисткой Ирой накануне помолвки. Её образ никак не вписывается в рамки привычной для Алексея жизни. Ира вносит хаос в его жизнь, а Алёна - наивная девушка, любит его таким, какой он есть, и мечтает стать его женой. Авантюризм Иры и ее готовность совершать безумные поступки дают Леше понять, что его жизнь может быть гораздо красочнее. Но готов ли он к авантюрным поступкам, когда на кону счастливое будущее с Аленой?

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond, a money launderer struggling with memory loss sustained in a car crash, goes on the run, evading the police while carrying heaps of stolen cash he knows nothing about. Moe and his partner in crime Bobby "Skunk" Cohen had been given a job by Bobby's uncle Perico, wherein he gave them a sum of $20 million to launder. However, the two are ambushed while doing a side job by corrupt police officers. The two manage to escape the cops, but soon after end up in a car accident.

programme.title: Falcon Rising
programme.desc: FAVELA, the first installment in the CODENAME: FALCON franchise, introduces former marine John "Falcon" Chapman, a dark anti-hero driven by guilt and suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder, who will destroy himself unless given something else to destroy - a useful weapon-of-last-resort for the U.S. State Department. When Chapman's sister is brutally attacked while on assignment in Brazil, Chapman flies into Sao Paulo to track down her assailants, quickly entering the city's seedy underbelly and discovering a world of drugs, the sex trade, corrupt cops, and organized crime syndicates battling for control.

programme.title: My Son, My Son, What Have Ye Done
programme.desc: The film begins with Detective Havenhurst driving with his partner Detective Vargas. They receive a call and drive to the scene of a murder. As they push their way through the crowd at the crime scene, they see Brad McCullam leaving with a coffee cup. Inside the house, the detectives find the body of Mrs. McCullam, Brad's mother, who has just been stabbed with an antique sword. At the scene are the neighbors and chief witnesses, Mrs. and Miss Roberts. The detectives soon realize that they had just seen the murderer leaving the scene.

programme.title: Irish Jam
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

programme.title: No Limit Kids
programme.desc: Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

programme.title: Raspberry Magic
programme.desc: "Raspberry Magic" is a coming-of-age story about 11-year-old Monica Shah, who thinks she must win the science fair in order to bring her father back after he runs out on the family. She blames herself for her parents' problems, and takes charge when her mother falls into a deep depression. Set behind the backdrop of a beautiful forest, Monica's experiment uses touch therapy to help raspberries grow faster. She asks, is it nature or nurture that can truly help a being grow? Does it even matter? Through her ups and downs with her family, she learns that it's a complex question, and the answer isn't so simple.

programme.title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
programme.desc: A backwoods team of Missouri kids race to solve a 100 year old mystery and save their friends in this family friendly action adventure. Chased deep into ancient caves they must escape treasure hunters hot on their trail or be lost forever.

programme.title: Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido
programme.desc: An Italian immigrant is thrust into the world of drug-lords, supercars and secret agents in this hilarious action comedy. After losing his job at the Disco Valet Company for undue heroism, Guido (Silvio Pollio) must pose as a Sicilian gangster for the FBI in order to infiltrate a powerful Asian gang. Things go sour and take a turn for the worse. Guido must now make amends before he is discovered and killed, or worse, deported.

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: Abigail, a self-sufficient single mom meets Ben. They both think every great relationship ends in disaster. On the first date they come up with 10 things to do together before they break up. But the estimated end is not so sure - because fate adds #11 to their list.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

programme.title: Wings Of Eagles
programme.desc: The continuing true story of Eric Liddell's glorious life after winning Olympic gold in the 1924 Paris Olympics. Liddell has returned to China, where he was born to missionary parents, modestly avoiding celebrity in order to teach local schoolchildren. In 1937, the Japanese invade China at the outset of WWll. Liddell with his friend Xu Niu, a street smart resistance fighter, recognize the increasing danger so Liddell sends his wife, Florence and their two daughters to safety in Canada. Duty-bound, Liddell stays to minister to the civilian victims. Liddell and other foreign nationals are taken as prisoners and placed in one of the many Japanese internment camps where they are forced to endure for two years. Before the Japanese surrender, Liddell succumbs to a brain tumor. Yet his message of hope became immortal. Eric Liddell's legacy continues to this day as he remains admired as a champion for life.

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: People You May Know
programme.desc: People You May Know follows Jed, a 30-something introvert who has managed to abstain from social media until now. When prompted with the gargantuan task of defining who he is, he realizes the life he can fake is much more interesting than the life he actually leads.

programme.title: Castle Falls
programme.desc: Action movie. After years of neglect, a building-landmark will be demolished with dynamite. What a few people know is that inside it hides the cash a gang leader stole from his rivals. Will the interested parties reach the treasure in time?

programme.title: That Trip We Took with Dad
programme.desc: This comedy drama tells the story of a Romanian-German family caught up in the political turmoil of 1968. They start a journey from the city of Arad to the German Democratic Republic, where the older son, Mihai hopes that surgical intervention for his ailing father will restore the family's harmony. Accompanied by Emil, the younger brother, they are caught in the aftermath of the Prague Spring, which alters their plans. Suddenly, they find themselves on the other side of the Iron Curtain in West Germany. In just a few hours, they have to decide: to stay or to go back home?

programme.title: Cleanskin
programme.desc: Harry (Sam Douglas), a British people arms dealer, is seen in bed with a prostitute named Rena (Shivani Ghai). While toying with Harry's pistol, she unloads it but replaces the empty magazine. Harry's bodyguard Ewan (Sean Bean) is a British Secret Intelligence Service. Harry and Ewan travel to a bank, transporting a briefcase of Semtex. The men are followed by two terrorists, Ash (Abhin Galeya) and Ibrahim (Mens-Sana Tamakloe). Ibrahim approaches Harry and Ewan from the top of a staircase, shooting at them. After Ash shoots Ewan twice, Harry tries to shoot Ash, only to discover there are no bullets in his gun. Ash kills Harry and takes the briefcase of Semtex. However, Ewan manages to shoot Ash in the arm; but, before he can apprehend him, Ash returns fire and escapes with the briefcase.

programme.title: Rummipäevik
programme.desc: Tele-esilinastus! Lõunamaisest päikesest, kaunitest naistest ja rummist küllastunud seikluslik lugu! Paul Kemp (Johnny Depp) avastab ühel päeval, et on lõplikul tüdinenud lärmakast ja hullumeelsest New Yorgist. Mees pakib asjad ja lendab paradiisi nimega Puerto Rico, et asuda tööle kohalikus ajalehes. Paul kohaneb kiiresti saare rummist nõretava elustiiliga, mille lahutamatuks osaks on ilusad naised. Teiste seast torkab Paulile eredalt silma meeletult veetlev Chenault (Amber Heard), kes on aga paraku kihlatud suurärimees Sandersoniga (Aaron Eckhart). Kui ta palkab Paul Kempi ülistama pressis oma järjekordset suurafääri, leiab ajakirjanik end valiku ees: kas kasutada oma sulge korrumpeerunud ärimeeste huvides või hoopis selleks, et see kamp maatasa teha…

programme.title: Tapa mind kolm korda
programme.desc: Charlie Wolf on professionaalne palgamõrtsukas, kes võtab vastu tööotsa, kus ta peab mõrvama kliendi naise. Ent olukord võtab huvitava pöörde, kui tuleb välja, et Charlie pole sugugi mitte ainukene, kellel on tulevase ohvriga asju ajada.

programme.title: Kolm Musketäri: Osa I - D'Artagnan
programme.desc: Noor D'Artagnan liitub kuninga kolme musketäriga, et üheskoos tagada Prantsusmaa tulevik.

programme.title: Tüdruk rongis
programme.desc: USA 2016 põnevik Lavastaja: Tate Taylor Osades: Emily Blunt, Haley Bennett, Rebecca Ferguson Hiljuti lahutatud Rachel Watson (Emily Blunt) mõtleb igal päeval New Yorki sõites majale, milles nad elasid koos ta endise abikaasa Tomiga (Justin Theroux). Ta märkab maja uut asukat Meganit (Haley Bennett) - imekena naist, kes kehastab kõike, mida ta tunneb endas kadunud olevat. Ühe reisi jooksul on ta tunnistajaks vägivaldsele riiule, mis leiab aset Megani ja ta abikaasa Scotti (Luke Evans) vahel. Rachel astub rongilt maha, ent kaotab siis ilmselt oma alkoholisõltuvuse tõttu teadvuse. Uuesti teadvusele tulles on ta verine ning marraskil. Kuna Megan on jäljetult kadunud, tõmmatakse Rachel eeslinna mürgitavasse ohtlikku maailma, mis on täis intriige ja saladusi.

programme.title: Tõotatud maa
programme.desc: R: Nickolaj Arcel. Tugev ajalooline draama, mis haarab nii narratiivi kui ka visuaalse küljega. Aastal 1755 asub vaesunud kapten Ludvig Kahlen (Mads Mikkelsen) vallutama karmi ja asustamata Taani nõmme-ala, et ehitada sinna koloonia kuninga nimel. Vastutasuks saab ta endale igatsetud tiitli. Piirkonna ainuvalitseja, sadismile kalduv Frederik de Schinkel (Simon Bennebjerg) usub aga, et nõmm kuulub talle ja kahe mehe vahel kasvavad pinged. Viimaks tuleb kaptenil de Schinkeliga riskantsesse võitlusesse asuda ja see seab ohtu teisigi. Parima filmi Kuldlõvi nominent Veneetsia festivalil.

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Окно жизни
programme.desc: Славик и Надежда оказываются жертвами квартирных аферистов, поэтому после рождения второго ребёнка они вынуждены жить с семьёй Славика. Его сестра Алёна недовольна таким соседством. Славик уезжает на заработки. Пользуясь тем, что Славик в коме, Алёна выгоняет Надежду с детьми из квартиры. После длительных скитаний Надежда оставляет младенца в бэби-боксе. Соколова и Борадзе предлагают Глаше уволиться по собственному желанию. Борадзе сообщает коллективу о том, что подкидыша усыновила семья Нескоромовых. Коллектив перинатального центра прощается с Милославской - сердце коллеги остановилось. Славик выходит из комы, Алёна признается ему в своем вранье.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: The Last War
programme.desc: "The Last War" is a documentary research project where leading thinkers from Ukraine and the West deconstruct the real history of the confrontation with Russia. The focus is on the true chronological framework of the conflict, which goes far beyond the last few years, and the phenomenon of Ukrainian resistance. The project clearly demonstrates how the myth of the Kremlin's "invincibility" is crumbling on the battlefield, and answers the main question: what will the world become after the collapse of the last empire and what will be considered Ukraine's final victory.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: As the Roman Empire expands its reaches into what is now Germany, its legions are faced with ferocious Germanic tribesmen. In 9 AD, their chieftain, Arminius, raised in Rome as a hostage of peace, uses his Roman military training to slaughter the Roman General Varus' army at Teutoburg Forest. This landmark battle establishes the Rhine River as the frontier between the Empire and its growing barbaric enemies. Six years later, when General Germanicus sets out across the Rhine for revenge, he finds heaps of bones and severed skulls nailed to trees - a reminder of the barbarians' victory. But at the Battle of the Weser River, he faces Arminius and wins. Germanicus captures Arminius' pregnant wife, Thusnelda, and parades her through the streets of Rome, as a symbol of his triumph.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: Some of the strangest and deadliest weapons ever built were prototypes of the modern gun. ANCIENT DISCOVERIES finds out whether a simple bamboo tube could have been the world's first gun. Hidden in an ancient manuscript lays a secret recipe for ancient tracer fire, but does it really work? How far and how high could the mega-mortar "Roaring Meg" have fired its shots to take out a Royalist stronghold? Can a team of experts discover the truth behind the bizarre battlefield phenomena of "wind of the cannonball," when men were seen to drop dead without apparently having been touched by a shot? And did a nine-barreled medieval volleygun mark the birth of the modern machine gun?

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: This unique documentary series explores what the planet would look like if all human life diappeared. With comment and opinion coming from scientists, engineers and other experts, this show speculates on how a lack of human intervention would impact on the environment and the other animal species. The show does not provide any explanation as to why humans have vanished from the face of the Earth but does surmise that human infrastructure is still present along with pets and domesticated livestock. Each episode explores what would happen to specific structures such as skyscrapers, bridges and dams or details the impact on human remains, artefacts and other objects. Some real-life abandoned locations are discussed and the show also uses CGI dramatisations to depict how the situation would look after one day, one week, one year, 10 years, 15 years, 25 years, 50 years, 100 years, 200 years, etc.

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Lost History
programme.desc: American history is vanishing one artifact at a time. Some of our most important historical and cultural treasures have been lost or stolen. Every year, dozens of treasures, from George Washington's teeth to the Apollo 11 moon landing tapes to even the iconic ground zero flag from the September 11 attacks, vanish from the shelves of famous museums, government archives and private collections. Now, host Brad Meltzer leads the hunt to return these treasures to their rightful owners–the American people. Many lost artifacts are circulating on the black market, but dozens of previously lost objects have already been found—by ordinary citizens—in attics, at garage sales and even online. Brad will also enlist the help of viewers, giving the public the chance to help restore our history too.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Cold War was one of paranoia and potential nuclear catastrophe. In the wreckages of missile sites, secret cities and crumbling nuclear facilities, join a team of historical detectives as they search for clues to understand how this "war" was played out and the secret structures that were constructed to arm the nation against attack. From fifteen-meter concrete walls to airtight steel doors and massive nuclear production plants, this episode reveals the awesome engineering that took place across America.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

With comment and opinion coming from scientists, engineers and other experts, this show speculates on how a lack of human intervention would impact on the environment and the other animal species. The show does not provide any explanation as to why humans have vanished from the face of the Earth but does surmise that human infrastructure is still present along with pets and domesticated livestock. Each episode explores what would happen to specific structures such as skyscrapers, bridges and dams or details the impact on human remains, artefacts and other objects. Some real-life abandoned locations are discussed and the show also uses CGI dramatisations to depict how the situation would look after one day, one week, one year, 10 years, 15 years, 25 years, 50 years, 100 years, 200 years, etc.

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Lost History
programme.desc: American history is vanishing one artifact at a time. Some of our most important historical and cultural treasures have been lost or stolen. Every year, dozens of treasures, from George Washington's teeth to the Apollo 11 moon landing tapes to even the iconic ground zero flag from the September 11 attacks, vanish from the shelves of famous museums, government archives and private collections. Now, host Brad Meltzer leads the hunt to return these treasures to their rightful owners–the American people. Many lost artifacts are circulating on the black market, but dozens of previously lost objects have already been found—by ordinary citizens—in attics, at garage sales and even online. Brad will also enlist the help of viewers, giving the public the chance to help restore our history too.

programme.title: Evolve
programme.desc: Throughout the eons of its existence, the natural world has played host to this never-ending competition called life. Since the dawn of time, roughly 99 percent of all species have become extinct. In order to survive, all creatures, including man, must treat life as a battlefield and master the natural weapons and defenses that they have evolved: Tyrannosaurus Rex's 13-inch canines; the Gecko's velcro-like toe pads; the Bald Eagle's telescopic vision capable of spotting a hare a mile away. How did these attributes, each unique to the organism itself, appear? Certainly not arbitrarily. They evolved for a common reason - to give these animals a critical edge in inter-species warfare, and to ensure the survival of the individual's genes into the next generation. To evolve is to survive!

programme.title: Ancient Top 10
programme.desc: Ancient Top 10 is smart, fun countdown that details how ancient technology worked, how surprisingly advanced it was, and how it was kind of awesome. Location shooting, CGI, and graphics are pulled from past History series Ancient Impossible and Ancient Discoveries, and lists are organized by themes. The stories are augmented by new entries fueled by the History archive. Episodes include updated "Top Ten" graphics and new interviews that provide "wow" facts and explain why something made the list. The lists will have organizing principles so it doesn't seem arbitrary. Episodes could include the following: Top 10 Secrets of Egypt, Top 10 Ancient Vikings, Top 10 Greek Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Weapons, Top 10 Ancient Monuments, Top 10 Ancient Ships, Top 10 Torture Devices, Top 10 Roman Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Swords, and Top 10 Ancient Sieges.

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Decoded
programme.desc: What if the history you knew was only half the story? Brad Meltzer's Decoded investigates the other half: the secret history of the symbols and codes that surround us everyday. Best-selling author Brad Meltzer has been writing novels for more than a decade. He has studied and written about some of the most revered institutions and documents in human history, including the U.S. Supreme Court, the Presidency, the Secret Service, Wall Street and the Bible. Brad has assembled a team to investigate the countless clues and theories uncovered through his years of research, but unexplored until now. From the dollar bill to the first Presidential Codes, the hidden messages of the Statue of Liberty and the ciphers protecting the location of lost Confederate gold, the team uncovers the truth behind history's most provocative secrets.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: oberts and Laidlaw have uncovered a fatal flaw in the Royal Navy's existing anti-U-Boat tactic 'Buttercup'. By wargaming different scenarios, they develop a countertactic of their own, codenamed 'Raspberry', in which a merchant convoy escorted by Royal Navy destroyers can lure in the wolfpack before surrounding and destroying it; in effect, playing the enemy at its own game. But the team now faces an uphill battle to try to convince Noble and his colleagues at the Admiralty that they hold the key to stopping the U-Boats in the Atlantic.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Ancient Discoveries
programme.desc: Have a look at the technologies from the past. You will be surprised to find out in what extent ancient knowledge influences modern technology. The truth about the past is much more complicated and fascinating than we imagine. This eye-opening series is filmed on location in Italy, Greece, Egypt, Holland, and England, and other locations of the world where historical events actually happened, and with the help of computer animation ancient machines and mechanisms are reconstructed. As well the series uses contributions from archaeologists and other experts, footage of historical sites and artifacts and dramatized reconstructions.

programme.title: Clash of the Gods
programme.desc: Documentary series that in each episode explains the heroic and tragic life of various figures from Greek and Norse mythologies - the most powerful monsters, heroes and Gods, including Thor, Hercules, Beowulf, Minotaur, Odysseus and Zeus. Was ancient Greece's greatest hero Hercules a real person? What inspired the Minotaur's labyrinth? Did Odysseus's famous journey really happen? This series will answer these and many other questions, and experts will connect the myths we all know to actual historical events, and link the stories to mythologies of other cultures as well.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Чудо по расписанию
programme.desc: Милая девушка Вероника как-то вечером выехала покататься на мотоцикле и была сбита пьяным водителем. Теперь она передвигается в инвалидной коляске и мечтает об операции, на которую у нее нет средств. Однажды она знакомится с Андреем, молодым, но преуспевающим адвокатом. Андрей почти женат, его невеста беременна и богата, но встреча с Вероникой переворачивает всю его жизнь...

programme.title: Второй брак
programme.desc: Настя Окунева приезжает в Москву и получает работу в крупной строительной компании, которой руководит подруга её покойной матери, Кира Георгиевна. Когда Кира Георгиевна скоропостижно умирает, управление компанией переходит к её сыну Глебу - холостому и привлекательному молодому человеку. Неожиданно для Насти он начинает оказывать ей знаки внимания и даже делает предложение. Девушка без ума от счастья, но до конца боится поверить, что это происходит наяву. Если бы она только знала, что у Глеба давно есть невеста Марина, а руку и сердце он предлагает ей только затем, чтобы получить наследство...

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Я иду тебя искать 4. Паранойя
programme.desc: Мила Пятница, выпускница юрфака, продолжает проходить практику в Управлении Внутренних дел ГУ МВД и заниматься дипломом в архиве ведомства. Неожиданно сам глава Управления Самойлов поручает Миле первое в ее жизни дело: Александр, приятель Самойлова, подозревает, что его хотят убить. Для всех очевидно, что с этой паранойей Александру нужно к психиатру, а не к следователям. Но Мила берется за дело, несмотря на скепсис и иронию коллег. А на следующий день Александра обнаруживают мертвым.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Главная героиня воспитывает двух детей от разных браков, заботится об отце-алкоголике и пытается наладить личную жизнь. Старшая дочь Анька учится в ПТУ, думает, что она единственный адекватный член семьи и в её жизни все будет по-другому, младший сын Тимофей, чей отец вернулся к первой семье в Азербайджан, считает, что он уже мужчина, хотя ему всего лишь 11 лет, отец Ольги, бывший футболист, крепко выпивает и постоянно врет, а сестра Ленка пытается жить за счет мужчин, в основном — женатых. Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

programme.title: Голое влечение
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Анатомия убийства
programme.desc: Жизнь элитного подмосковного поселка полна тайн, а о способности Евгении Волковой разгадывать эти самые тайны известно всем. Популярная актриса просит Евгению разобраться со странными явлениями, которые происходят в доме - ей кажется, что кто-то планомерно сводит ее с ума. Евгения и Карский пытаются распутать клубок интриг, в центре которых оказалась актриса, и не замечают, что в их ближайшем окружении тоже не все ладно. И вот однажды исчезает помощник Карского - скромный парень Гриша. Пытаясь разыскать его, герои понимают, что он совсем не тот, за кого себя выдавал. Зачем наследнику огромного состояния работать за гроши? И куда он делся?

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Главная героиня воспитывает двух детей от разных браков, заботится об отце-алкоголике и пытается наладить личную жизнь. Старшая дочь Анька учится в ПТУ, думает, что она единственный адекватный член семьи и в её жизни все будет по-другому, младший сын Тимофей, чей отец вернулся к первой семье в Азербайджан, считает, что он уже мужчина, хотя ему всего лишь 11 лет, отец Ольги, бывший футболист, крепко выпивает и постоянно врет, а сестра Ленка пытается жить за счет мужчин, в основном — женатых. Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

programme.title: CNN Newsroom
programme.desc: CNN Newroom provides the most up to date news as it breaks and is the longest running show on the channel, airing twice a day Monday to Friday and throughout the day over the weekends. CNN has developed a lot since its founding in 1980 by American media proprietor Ted Turner as a 24 hour cable news channel. As an organisation, CNN have won multiple awards, including a network-record six news & documentary Emmy Awards in 2018.

programme.title: U.S. State of the Union Address
programme.desc: The Speech is addressed to the Congress and the American people. It aims to highlight administration work and its victories, target political enemies and demonstrate the President's vision for the whole country.

programme.title: Fareed Zakaria GPS
programme.desc: Weekly public affairs show hosted by an American journalist, political scientist, and author Fareed Zakaria. The show is broadcasted on CNN every Sunday in many countries of the world. The "GPS" in the show's title stands for "Global Public Square," a reference to the show's focus on international issues and foreign affairs. The guests of the show's one-on-one interviews and roundtable discussions are most prominent figures in the world of global politics, economy and global decision-makers and influencers.

programme.title: African Voices
programme.desc: Baillor Jalloh, Nkululeko Sibanda and guests, African perspectives on topical issues

programme.title: Marketplace Middle East
programme.desc: Business show revolves around cutting edge economic trends and latest business developments in the Middle East. The focus is on the key cities of the region, its most important sectors and industries. The guests of the show are significant representatives of the business community in the region.

programme.title: Marketplace Africa
programme.desc: Unique access to the latest African market information, with a look at events and developments that impact its business world. Follow the business stories that influence the African continent. Eleni Giokos is a CNN correspondent based in the network's Johannesburg bureau and the show's host. Every week she interviews figures of business and industry to reveal the economic trends in various regions of Africa and to present the continent's key sectors and corporations.

programme.title: Seasons
programme.desc: A brand-new global series on CNN that explores the shifting trends shaping global culture—across fashion, travel, food, technology, design, and art.

programme.title: Inside Africa
programme.desc: Each week, Inside Africa documentary series on CNN highlights the unique diversity of mysterious Africa, its numerous cultures and religions, peoples, art, music, cuisine, travel and literature, its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna. Watch the interviews with people from various spheres of life and find out more surprising facts about this continent: how it fights for conservation of rare animals, who the new figures in fashion and design are, what the new educational programs for children look like. Everything what Africa is filled with and lives for is in this series.

programme.title: Connecting Africa
programme.desc: The African continent is going through a big transformation and this CNN magazine presents the entrepreneurs, companies and projects that are working hard to modernise it and make its economic integration possible. programme.title: The Lead with Jake Tapper
programme.desc: CNN's chief Washington correspondent, Jake Tapper, hosts this hour-long weekday afternoon program, which covers all the day's top stories from around the country and the world, headlines that span politics, money, sports and popular culture. 'The Lead' works to ensure that viewers are caught up on the stories that matter, often highlighting news that may have been overlooked. Prior to joining CNN, Tapper served as senior White House correspondent at ABC News.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Amazing World of Gumball revolves around the life of Gumball Watterson a 12-year-old cat who attends middle school in the fictional city of Elmore. Accompanied by his adoptive goldfish brother and best friend Darwin he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city during which he interacts with his other family members - sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard - and an extended supporting cast of characters. With relatable themes and a unique cast of characters The Amazing World of Gumball exemplifies the funny amazing sweet and optimistic side of kids' everyday life. Injected with a good deal of humor and unpredictable nonsense Gumball's world reflects the modern family and everyday issues that kids understand.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: When Darwin asks Gumball to teach him how to skate Gumball makes sure that he covers every aspect of the skating lifestyle - from wearing the right gear using the right terms and choosing the right board. programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Amazing World of Gumball revolves around the life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year-old cat who attends middle school in the fictional city of Elmore. Accompanied by his adoptive goldfish brother and best friend Darwin, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with his other family members - sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard - and an extended supporting cast of characters. With relatable themes and a unique cast of characters, The Amazing World of Gumball exemplifies the funny, amazing, sweet and optimistic side of kids' everyday life. Injected with a good deal of humor and unpredictable nonsense, Gumball's world reflects the modern family and everyday issues that kids understand.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball sets out to solve the mystery of who stuffed Principal Brown into his locker. / Gumball and Darwin's harmless pranks on Dad spiral hopelessly out of control. / Gumball and Darwin's martial arts costumes make them a laughing stock at school. / Gumball is traumatised when accidentally kissed on the mouth by his Grandma JoJo. / Gumball and Darwin are invited to a high school party and have to bring a date! / Gumball and Darwin unsuccessfully attempt to get a refund for their computer game. / Gumball discovers that Bobert is planning to take over his identity and replace him! / Gumball and Darwin barely survive a school picnic in the Forest of Doom. / Gumball sets out to win his Dad back by winning a blindfolded "dumb" race.

Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Papad Mammad
programme.desc: Vanaisa Jüri saab politseist vabaks, aga papade-mammade üürikest rõõmu varjutab uus probleem: Lenna on sigarettidele ligi saanud. Papad-mammad kehtestavad nüüd igasuguse suitsu-, alkoholi- ja rämpstoidukeelu, et Lennast jälle normaalne laps saaks. See keelusüsteem ei näi aga kõigile hästi sobivat ja õhus ongi juba uued intriigid. Lõpuks kaob aga Lenna koos naabripoisiga ja algavad suured otsingud.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Sarja teises osas tekib naabrimeestel (Peeter Oja ja Sepo Seeman) piiritüli, sest Viksi (Andrus Vaarik) salaplaan miljonite saamiseks nõuab kahe maja vahele tara ehitamist. Samal ajal lähevad õed (Merle Palmiste ja Hilje Murel) meeste pärast kaklema. Kogu tohuvabohu keskele saabub äkki ämm (Ene Järvis), et istutada noori õunapuid. Režissöör Rando Pettai, stsenarist Peep Pedmanson.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: SARJA FINAALEPISOOD. UUS! Laura peab elukaaslase karjääri tõttu Eestist lahkuma ja otsustab suure lahkumispeo korraldada, samas kui Maria suhtleb oma nõustamistöö tõttu ülimalt salapärase mehega. Miša tahab Saaremaal Metsiku Lääne stiilis rantšo avada ja Kristinal on kõigile täielik pommuudis. Viimases osas lahvatavad kired, õiendatakse arved ja valatakse nii helluse kui rõõmupisaraid. Selge on see, et pöörastes intriigides karastunud sõbrannad on terveks eluks!

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein puudub töölt ja otsustab poliitikast lahkuda. Jaoskonna naispatrullid Veronika Mitler ja Relika Solnoskova lähevad viimaks täielikult tülli. Rein otsustab oma elu jälle korda teha ja vajab selleks Relika abi, kes aitab Reinul oma naisele raseduseteemaliste anonüümkirjade lugu selgitada. See käik sunnib aga Relikat oma lapse isa paljastama ja saladus hakkab õmblustest kärisema. Erakond ei taha häältemagnetist Reinu lahti lasta ja võtab kasutusele alatud võtted. Lisaks läheb konstaabel Sile ja spioonikomisjoni juhi Siim-Sanderi salaplaan väga hapuks.

programme.title: Lõks
programme.desc: Alex kohtub uue politseiülema Leevikesega ning ootamatu kohtumine osutub üsna ehmatavaks. Alex ei tea enam keda usaldada, keda mitte. Ärimees leiab oma maja trepilt koju tulles selga tulistatud mehe elutu keha. Mõrvarühm teeb kindlaks, et tegemist on elukutselise vargaga. Kahtlus langeb esialgu ärimehele, ent miskit ei klapi. Uurimise käigus hakkab tunduma, et lasud olid mõeldud hoopis kellegile teisele. Ent miks ja kelle saadetud olid need kuulid? Lugu hakkab tasapisi hargnema, segased kahtlused selginema. Kui kriminalistikalabor uudset meetodit kasutades õrna jälje kindlaks teeb on asi selge ja valgusvihku satub seni varjus olnud tegelik süüdlane.

programme.title: Nurjatud tüdrukud
programme.desc: "Nurjatud tüdrukud" on musta huumori ja põnevusega vürtsitatud draamasari, mille tegevuspaigaks on raskestikasvatavate tüdrukute kinnine õppeasutus. Sinna saabub eraeluprobleemide käest põgenev kriminaalpsühholoog Markus Tamm, kes satub silmitsi uute ja eelmisest veelgi keerulisemate probleemidega. Markusega samal päeval saabub kooli uus õpilane Hanna, kes on peamine kahtlusalune tuntud ärimehe mõrvas.

programme.title: Kullakesed
programme.desc: Dorothy, Blanche, Rose ja Sophia on neli eakat vanadaami. Nende kõigi suurimaks ühiseks jooneks on nende abikaasad - kõik on kas surnud või lahutand. Neli vanamemme otsustavad kokku kolida, et vanaduspõlve hõlpsamaks ning huvitavamaks teha.Kuid samas pole mitte ühelgi neist kadunud ammune janu meeste järgi. Igaüks üritab endale pidevalt kaaslast leida ning vahest ka teiselt üle trumbata.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Reinul õnnestub Eduard Kitzbergi ja Hans-Kristjani abil Siim-Sanderi skeemid paljastada ja ta otsustab poliitikast "suure pauguga" otseeetris lahkuda, paljastades korraga kõik räpased mängud. Salakaval Urmas peab nüüd jällegi pooli valima ja paljastatud konstaabel Sile satub lõksu. Kogu jaoskond teab juba, et Urmas on Relika lapse isa ja Relika peab seda nüüd ka Urmasele endale ütlema. Rein naudib võidurõõmu sahkerdajate üle ja just siis, kui tundub, et kõik lõpeb hästi, juhtub midagi täiesti šokeerivat.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Rebekka (Merle Palmiste) tahab saada last, aga Raivo (Peeter Oja) ei kipu sellest arugi saama ning tegeleb hoopis Viksi (Andrus Vaarik) mahitatud veinikollektsiooni ostutehinguga. Riinal (Hilje Murel) aga tekib kahtlus, et õde noolib tema meest Urmast (Sepo Seeman). Suhtenelinurka kihutab viienda rattana ämm (Ene Järvis) ning tulemuseks on muidugi avarii. Režissöör Rando Pettai, stsenarist Peep Pedmanson.

programme.title: Beverly Hills, 90210
programme.desc: Dylani sõbrad soovivad, et ta läheks võõrutusravile. Kellyle pakutakse võimalust, millest miljonid tüdrukud unistavad. Ray läheb Donna vanematega õhtusöögile. Dylan sõidab heroiini mõju all autoga kaljult alla.

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.title: Võõramaalane
programme.desc: Claire läheb Dougali ja tema meestega koos reisile. Jamie ja Claire suhted süvenevad.

programme.title: Rannavalve
programme.desc: Ühes Los Angelese rannas tegutseb vetelpäästjate rühm, mida juhib Mitch Buchannon. Nad päästavad elusid, maadlevad eraeluliste muredega, võitlevad kuritegevuse vastu ja löövad kaasa uskumatutes seiklustes.

programme.title: Papad Mammad
programme.desc: Volli on peale putkavarga tabamist kangelaseks saanud, siis aga selgub, et ta on töölt koondatud ja papad-mammad ei suuda Vollile seda uudist kuidagi edasi öelda. See ümber palava pudru käimine vallandab aga lõpuks tõelise meeleheitetormi.

programme.title: Kired
programme.desc: Sarja peategelasteks on kaks abielupaari, kelle suhted muudab keeruliseks ühe paari naise ja teise paari mehe vahel puhkenud kirg. 1998. aastal TV3 eetris jooksma hakanud seriaali stsenaariumi autorid olid Aita Kivi, Juhan Habicht ja Stella K. Wadowsky, toimetaja Tiina Lokk, näitejuht Rein Oja, režissöörid Toomas Kirss ja Kalev Lepik. Peaosadesmängisid Merle Palmiste, Marika Vernik, Ita Ever, Märt Visnapuu ja Ivo Uukkivi. Produtsent oli Toomas Kirss.

programme.title: Kolmeraudne
programme.desc: Vestlussaates Kolmeraudne on Mihkel Raua tuttavas raudses haardes nädala kuumemad tegelased tipp-poliitikutest kultuurikorüfeedeni, lisaks esineb igas saates üks ansambel.

programme.title: Saare sosinad
programme.desc: Kodumaine draamasari, mille sündmustik viib meid päikselisele Madeira saarele. Ärimees Madis (Jaan Rekkor) viib oma verinoore pruudi Lini (Marilyn Jurman) sinna mesinädalatele, kuid ootamatult selgub, et Madise pangakaardid on suletud. Sama lennuga saabub ka kaitsepolitsei uurija Kaire (Viire Valdma), kes peab lahti harutama ühe saarelviibija hämara mineviku. Alguse saab ootamatute pööretega lugu, mida vürtsitavad romantika, saladused ja põnevus. Teistes kesksetes rollides Marika Vaarik, Indrek Sammul, Tiit Sukk, Helene Vannari, Margus Tabor ja Inga Salurand.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: Marylandi pärijanna ja tema pereliikmete surnukehad leitakse nende söögitoa laualt ning rühmal tuleb leida üles teised pereliikmed ja sõbrad, et saada jälile saladustele, mis selle verepulma põhjuseks olla võisid. Hotch aga püüab sõlmida rahu oma endise äiaga, kui selgub, et tollel diagnoositud Alzheimeri tõbi on süvenemas.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond
programme.desc: Luureosakond tahab Olinsky nimel õiglust jalule seada, kui teda vanglas pussitatakse. Antonio lojaalsus pannakse proovile. Woods tahab Voighti lõplikult hävitadal.

programme.title: Hudson ja Rex
programme.desc: Kui pulbitsevas ööelust tuntud piirkonnas tapetakse politseinik, kitseneb uurimine grupile mereväeohvitseridele.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: CSI uurib rikaste investorite kasiino avamise maskeraadi käigus õhatud pommi tagamaid.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Kui Monki ülakorruse naaber ära kägistatakse, avastab Monk, et mees alustas hiljuti uut karjääri mustkunstnikuna. Monki kahtlus langeb koheselt ohvri mentorile, kes oli aga samal õhtul mitmesaja kilomeetri kaugusel Renos.

programme.title: Tark mees taskus
programme.desc: Ekstsentriline raamatupoe omanik ja endine spioon Book aitab 1950. aastate Londonis politseil keerulisi mõrvu lahendada. Noor endine vang Jack asub poes tööle ja saab sooja vastuvõtu osaliseks, ent hakkab peagi kahtlustama, et teda ei värvatud juhuslikult.

programme.title: Surmarelv
programme.desc: Legendaarsetel "Surmarelva" filmidel põhinev veriväske action-komöödiasari toob taas kokku kinoajaloo vingeima detektiivide paari! Oma naist leinav endine eriüksuslane Martin Riggs (Clayne Crawford) ja pärast infarkti tööle naasev Roger Murtaugh (Damon Wayans) moodustavad üdini vastandliku, aga ometi ideaalselt toimiva tandemi. Nende koostöö algus on okkaline, sest ohjeldamatu Riggsi pea-ees-tulle-sööstmise suhtumine põrkub vaoshoitud Murtaugh arusaamadega. Esimese ühise juhtumi lõppedes mõistavad aga mõlemad, et on lisaks uuele paarimehele leidnud endale ka parima sõbra.

programme.desc: Adrian Monk on üks San Francisco politseijaoskonna parimaid töötajaid, kuid pärast abikaasa traagilist surma on kõik muutunud: andekast detektiivist sai üleöö ettearvamatu ja impulsiivne inimene, kellel on ebanormaalsed hirmud ja kes ärritub väga kergesti. Sellest hoolimata püüab Monk oma tööd edasi teha, kuid sellel on ettearvamatud tagajärjed.

programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Õudne film 2
programme.desc: USA 2001 õuduskomöödia Lavastaja: Keenen Ivory Wayans Osades: Anna Faris, Natascha Lyonne, Tori Spelling, James Woods, Tim Curry, Chris Elliot jpt. Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) pole ikka veel suutnud üle saada aastatagustest koledustest, kui ta peab juba vastu astuma uutele õudustele. Professor Oldman (Tim Curry) meelitab rühma tudengeid vanasse majja, et uurida selles asuvat kummitust. On maailma suurim marihuaanatarbija Jupats (Marlon Wayans), on Ray (Shawn Wayans), kes pole ikka veel kindel oma seksuaalsetes eelistustes, aga on ka rida uusi tegelasi, kes üsna ruttu seal Põrgumajas kõik surmaohtu satuvad. "Õudne film 2" pakub kõike sedasama, mida eelmisel aastal maailma kinod vallutanud esimene film: halastamatult halba maitset ja jõhkraid nalju lugematute õudusfilmide aadressil. Osades esimesest filmist tuttavad Anna Faris ning ka stsenaristidena tegutsenud Shawn ja Marlon Wayans. Lisaks neile James Woods ("Süütud enesetapud"), Tim Curry ("Charlie inglid"), Chris Elliot ("Kõiges on süüdi Mary"), Natascha Lyonne ("Kuum pirukas") ning Tori Spelling ja Kathleen Robertson ("Beverly Hills 90210").

programme.title: Kiirperekond
programme.desc: Kiirperekond on moodne ja emotsionaalne komöödia, mis jutustab loo Elliest (Rose Byrne) ja Pete'ist (Mark Wahlberg), kes otsustavad saada kasuvanemateks. Teinud algust lapsendamisprotsessiga ja valides potentsiaalset kasvandikku, tekib neil endalegi üllatuseks hea side ühe iseteadliku 15-aastase tüdrukuga (Isabela Moner). Kuid siis selgub, et ninakal teismelisel on ka nunnu pisiõde ja väikevend ning enne veel kui Ellie ja Pete saavad aru oma valiku tagajärgedest, on nad lapsendanud kamba põngerjaid, kel pole mingit huvi saada hästi kasvatatud lasteks.

programme.title: Suhete mänguväljak
programme.desc: Jalgpallurist südametemurdja satub saatuse tahtel laste jalgpallimeeskonna treeneriks. Sellest hetkest muutub jalgpalliplats tema hoolealuste ja nende veetlevate emade suhete mänguväljakuks.

programme.title: Mu kallis nõiamoor
programme.desc: Jack Wyatt (Will Farrell) üritab saada sureliku peaosalise Darrini rolli samanimelise eduka 1960. aastate teleseriaali "Nõiutud" põhjal vändatavas filmis, mis võiks Jacki karjäärile uue hoo sisse anda, aga puudu on vaid üks oluline element - täiuslik Samantha, sarja teine peategelane. Kui Jack tutvub Isabeli (Nicole Kidman), heasüdamliku naisega, kes tahab vaid täiesti tavapärast elu elada, on Jack temast koheselt sisse võetud ja samas ka sügavalt veendunud, et Isabel peaks olema tema partner nii filmis kui ka elus. Paraku pole tal aimugi, et Isabel on päriselt nõid ja õige ruttu keerab nende tutvumine mõlema elu pea peale. Filmis teevad kaasa ka Shirley MacLaine ja Michael Caine. Tegu on uusversiooniga klassikalisest komöödiasarjast, mis käsitles armulugu erinevatest maailmadest pärit inimeste vahel ja jõudis tõdemuseni, et armastus võidab kõik.

programme.title: Nõiduslik lelupood
programme.desc: Ekstsentriline mänguasjapoe omanik soovib pensionile jääda ja palkab raamatupidaja. Häbelik noormees peab vormistama lelupoe ümber Molly-nimelise tütarlapse nimele, kes on kaotanud huvi elu vastu.

programme.title: Saage tuttavaks - Dave
programme.desc: USA 2008 komöödia Lavastaja: Brian Robbins Osades: Eddie Murphy, Elizabeth Banks, Marc Blucas, Gabrielle Union, Ed Helms, Scott Caan Värskelt New Yorki saabunud Dave Ming Chang (Eddie Murphy) on otsekui kala kuival. Miski tema juures on viltu, mees näeb kõike ümbritsevat otsekui esimest korda ega tunne end oma kehas kuigi mugavalt. Põhjusega, sest tegelikult ei olegi "Dave" üldse inimene, vaid hoopis teiselt planeedilt saabunud… kosmoselaev, mis on loodud oma kapteni (Eddie Murphy) näo järgi. Avastusretk tundmatusse maailma alaku!

programme.title: Õelad tüdrukud
programme.desc: USA 2004 Komöödia Lavastaja: Mark S. Waters Osades: Lindsay Lohan, Rachel McAdams, Lacey Chabert, Amanda Seyfried Cady Heron (Lindsay Lohan) on 15-aastane tüdruk, kes on terve elu koos zooloogidest vanematega Aafrika põõsaste all veetnud. Nüüd peab ta astuma aga tavalisse kooli ning kogeb omal nahal, et dzhungliseadused seal ei kehti. Tema teadmised ja arvamused olelusvõitlusest saavad hoopis uue tähenduse. Pikkus: 1 tund 37 minutit

programme.title: Valusad võmmid
programme.desc: Inglismaa 2007 märulikomöödia Lavastaja: Edgar Wright Osades: Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Jim Broadbent, Paddy Considine, Timothy Dalton Nicholas Angel (Simon Pegg) on Londoni edukaim politseinik, kelle tulemused on kolleegide omadest ligi 400% paremad. Ta on lausa nii suurepärane, et kõik teised tunduvad tema kõrval kahvatud. Seetõttu otsustatakse mees saata väikelinna Sandfordi, kus ta täht ei lööks niivõrd särama. Algul näiline tagasilöök saab aga väärt kulminatsiooni, kui Sandfordis hakkab juhtuma rida kummalisi ja veriseid juhtumeid. Uinuval väikelinnal on aeg saada tubli annus suurlinna õiglust. Pikkus: 2 tundi 1 minutit

programme.title: Mees Kuu pealt
programme.desc: Kaheosaline film koomik Andy Kaufmani elust. Näiteja võis kehastada keda iganes soovis - vaikset ja lapsemeelset meest, ülbet ja agressiivset maadlejat või maailma halvimat salongilauljat.
Endiste kurjategijate jõuk röövib Elvis Presley kokkutuleku ajal kasiinot.

programme.title: Hoodie
programme.desc: "Hoodie" on superkangelase lugu täiesti tavalisest poisist, kellel on erakordne parkuuri talent ja õiglustunne. Nüüd on ta juba kaks aastat harjutanud parkuurimist Soufianiga, Brüsseli parima jäljekütiga. Ta teeb seda salaja, sest tema ema, innukas politseinik, ei kiidaks seda iial heaks. Kui kolm naabruskonna last Flo, Basim ja Kenza avastavad Pieteri talendi ja motivatsiooni, ühinevad nad ootamatuks superkangelaste tiimiks nimega tiim Hoodie. Neid ühendab üks eesmärk - vabastada naabruskond ülekohtust.

Kui kolm naabruskonna last Flo, Basim ja Kenza avastavad Pieteri talendi ja motivatsiooni, ühinevad nad ootamatuks superkangelaste tiimiks nimega tiim Hoodie. Neid ühendab üks eesmärk - vabastada naabruskond ülekohtust.
